s01: The purple nucleus inside the round cell gently pulses in size and the gold membrane ring brightens slightly then dims. Nothing else moves.
s02: The three gold dots on the horizontal line pulse one after another from left to right, each growing slightly then returning to size. The line and all other elements stay still.
s03: The two rounded boxes glow in turn: the top box outline brightens then dims, then the bottom box does the same. Nothing else moves.
s04: In the prokaryotic cell the teal DNA strand gently wiggles in place and the red ribosome dots drift slightly; in the eukaryotic cell the purple nucleus pulses subtly and the red dots drift slightly. Outlines stay fixed.
s05: A soft highlight sweeps down across the table rows once from top to bottom, then fades. The cells do not move.
s06: In the plant cell the light-blue vacuole slowly swells and shrinks slightly and the green plastid drifts a little; in the animal cell the purple nucleus pulses gently. All outlines stay fixed.
